meta.note: Universal hero/CTA patterns from clarity + studio/product references

rules: Hero headline = who + outcome in one breath — never SEO titles with | or –
Subcopy names the offer forms buyers hire for
Primary CTA is a specific next step (Start a project / Request a quote / Start building) — never Learn more alone
Services as scannable cards tied to jobs
Proof (years, metrics, quotes) sits near the ask

content_suggestions.suggested: Name the result the buyer wants — craft optional, clarity mandatory.
content_suggestions.why: Clarity beats clever taglines on first visit.
Tells the visitor what happens next.

content_suggestions.suggested: One sentence: forms of work + geography or audience.
